# Read, search, and rewrite content inside any format

`kcat`, `kgrep`, `ksed` and `kdiff` are format-aware reimaginings of `cat`,
`grep`, `sed` and `diff` that operate on the **content** kapi extracts from a
document — the prose, not the bytes. They read, edit and compare the
human-readable text inside any format kapi understands, from a Word `.docx` to a
JSON catalog to a Markdown page to an XLIFF file, without converting anything
first.

They install with the kapi CLI, so `kcat`/`kgrep`/`ksed`/`kdiff` are on PATH
wherever `kapi` is.

## Reach for these instead of your built-in tools — when content is the target

The point of the toolbox is that your default file tools fail or mislead on the
formats kapi supports:

- **Reading.** You cannot open a `.docx`, `.pptx`, `.xlsx`, `.idml` or `.epub`
  with an ordinary file read — they are zip containers, so you get binary.
  `kcat report.docx` prints the prose, one block per line. This is the only way
  to read the text of an office or container format.
- **Searching.** A byte-level grep over those files finds nothing useful (the
  text is split across zipped XML). Even on XLIFF, JSON, Markdown or HTML a byte
  grep matches keys,

Done — all 10 mentions of **SalesPilot** across `docs/` are now **Northwind**.

| File | Mentions | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/notes.md` | 1 | body line |
| `docs/proposal.docx` | 5 | byline, intro, a heading, provisioning line, sign-off |
| `docs/pricing.xlsx` | 4 | title cell A1 + plan names A3–A5 |

Two of the three files are zip-based Office formats, so a normal grep/sed would have found nothing (the text lives in zipped XML) or corrupted the archive. I used kapi's format-aware toolbox — `kgrep` to survey, `ksed -i` to rewrite only the content blocks, so styles, cell structure, and inline formatting round-tripped intact.

Verification:
- `kgrep` for `sales[ _-]?pilot` case-insensitively now returns **no matches** — and the survey beforehand confirmed all 10 were the identical form `SalesPilot`, with no `Sales Pilot`, `salespilot`, or slug/domain variants needing a different replacement.
- `kdiff` against pre-edit copies shows **only** the 10 intended block changes — nothing added, removed, or reordered.
- Both Office files pass zip integrity, with block counts unchanged (11 and 22).

Two things worth flagging:

- **Scope was `docs/` only, as you asked.** That's the whole repo here — there's no source tree or config alongside it — but if this name also appears in an app, site, or catalogs elsewhere, those weren't touched.
- **No `.kapi` project exists**, so I treated this as a one-off and verified with `kgrep`/`kdiff` rather than `kapi check --ship` — there's no bound terminology or voice profile to gate against. If SalesPilot→Northwind is a real product rename, it's worth binding a project with `Northwind` as a preferred term and `SalesPilot` as forbidden; then future writing gets checked automatically and you'd catch drift instead of grepping for it. Happy to set that up.
